sentences.en: His muscles ached from sitting too long in one position.
sentences.zh: 他长时间保持一个姿势坐着，肌肉疼。

sentences.en: It hurts to even walk with my thigh muscles aching.
sentences.zh: 连走动都感到大腿肌肉酸痛。

sentences.en: According to my sister, my muscles are in my head.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐说我的力气都在脑袋里。

senses.zh: 加强；使劲搬动；使劲挤出 -
